purpose: Deployment experiments and measurement targets; does not alter active training or certify an app release.

target.initial_testing: Android Studio emulator for app behavior; physical device required for performance acceptance
target.interaction: One captured photo at a time
target.runtime_candidate: LiteRT (.tflite), without Python/PyTorch in the APK

pinned_export_api.fp16_note: This pinned LiteRT exporter uses FP16 through the GPU delegate at runtime; it does not support a separate half=True LiteRT export.
pinned_export_api.export_environment: Separate from the active training environment; export dependencies not installed by the preview tool

optional_future_training_candidate.status: Superseded by the 2000-photo compact profile: reuse TACO-only L1 and train compact rock/log YOLOv8n.

design_targets_not_measurements.status: Provisional targets; accuracy and actual physical-phone measurements determine acceptance

app_memory_policy: Decode a sampled bitmap with correct orientation, then letterbox to the selected input size
Keep the original photograph as a file rather than retaining multiple full-resolution bitmaps
Reuse one interpreter and input/output buffers; serialize inference
Reconstruct selected masks at model resolution and map overlays to display coordinates
Release temporary camera tensors and bitmaps after the result is displayed
Package the selected runtime model and class/preprocessing metadata; keep datasets and training checkpoints outside the APK
